name: Mary Cognetti

residences.note: Survived husband John T. Petriello Sr. (d. 1 Mar 2025); family parish Holy Rosary, funeral at St. Gregory, Clarks Green. Town not stated for her explicitly.

bioAdditions: No death record or obituary for Mary (Cognetti) Petriello was found as of 8 Oct 2026: searches of the web, the Scranton Times-Tribune / Legacy indexes (via search engines), Echovita and the Solfanelli-Fiorillo funeral-home site turned up nothing after her husband's March 2025 obituary, which names her as surviving spouse 'Mary Cognetti Petriello' (S1). She is therefore still presumed living. The Nov 2016 newspaper story on the 50th Cognetti family Thanksgiving (S2, already on the site) carried a staff photograph of Mary Petriello (83) and her brother Leo Cognetti (87) looking over the 186-name Cognetti family tree compiled by their niece Maria Cognetti (daughter of Joseph F. and Domenica Cognetti); the photo is copyrighted and was not downloaded.
